configuration: Executes a byte-for-byte copy of code/mrsimulator/examples_source/1D_simulation(crystalline)/plot_13_quad_dipolar.py; nominal dimensions and physics are not reduced.
observable: Every real and imaginary sample of each complex frequency-domain spectrum emitted by each upstream Simulator.run call, in physical CSDM grid order.
default_vs_upstream: exact: nominal executes the pinned official script at its original sites, isotopes, couplings, methods, rotor settings, point counts, and spectral widths.
variant: Before the first run of each Simulator object, the runner moves the first finite nonzero active site, tensor, coupling, or method input upward by exactly two binary64 ulps; the nominal official script is unchanged.

evidence.floor_how: Native linux/arm64 and Docker-emulated linux/amd64 calibration records are preserved in comment/pipeline; the floor is their nominal-spectrum maximum absolute difference.

altbuild: none: the packaged Python extension is compiled once in the image and this check has no independent in-run build configuration.
warrant: The ordered CSDM grid is the physical spectrum consumed by the official example, so pointwise real/imaginary comparison detects missing transitions, wrong spin parameters, omitted couplings, incorrect MAS/field settings, and interpolation errors. The finalized atol=1e-10 and rtol=1e-7 bound was approved after full arm64 and amd64 calibration: spectrum scale 28.8097657, largest same-build nominal/variant spread 8.98e-13, and cross-architecture nominal floor 6.78e-13.
